body:
### Broader libraries screened after the failed sequence-response fit

The bounded [Presto source screen](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/codex/modular-presto-model-20261020/experiments/2026-10-26_0344_codex_diverse-quantity-anchors/README.md) does not admit another broad nontryptic response panel. Bohrer2010's libraries have tryptic-like termini. Jagannadham2021/PXD017992 is mostly tryptic, with nontryptic coverage and independently assigned amount-to-response joins unverified. Direct repository metadata access failed through the web tool; this does not establish missing files.

Please retain these exclusions/unknowns in future calibration admission: advertised library size and nominal stock mass are insufficient evidence for independently known nontryptic peptide doses. This extends the existing request for explicit purity/amount uncertainty, on-column dose, forms, separate raw responses and physical acquisition links; no additional issue owner or parser is needed. No new model was fitted.

The next source audit will follow the existing APC-derived endolysosomal lead in #812, keeping matched-response changes distinct from baseline intracellular quantities. #849 remains open for true response anchors and protocol bridging.
